visual_environment.illumination: Low private screen/electronic glow close to the face, with the surrounding world dropping quickly into dark.
visual_environment.palette: Black, cool gray, muted blue-green, cathode or screen blue, and tiny warm skin accents.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Interior, close-miked, insulated, hyper-attentive, and nearly silent outside the immediate listening space.
visual_environment.motion: Minimal external motion; tiny repetitive or nervous movement can become large through attention.
visual_environment.density: Sparse and intimate, with sensory information compressed close to the subject.
visual_environment.material_effects: Film grain and paper texture become more apparent in the dark; small light leaks, contact-sheet edges, or headphone-cable lines may act as private annotations.

visual_environment.illumination: Hard small-room red/white stage light with deep black falloff and practical lamps close to bodies.
visual_environment.palette: Red-black, nicotine amber, dirty white, dark denim/gray, and occasional electric accent.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Sweat-close, nervy, immediate, crowded, and slightly abrasive.
visual_environment.motion: Jitter, twitch, short explosive gesture, shoulder-to-shoulder movement.
visual_environment.density: High near bodies/stage, quickly collapsing into dark at the room edges.
visual_environment.material_effects: Fast grain, imperfect flash, blurred limbs, clipped highlights, scratched print or Xerox-like contrast can surface without erasing family grammar.

visual_environment.illumination: Warm low gold from a formal proscenium or concert-hall lighting rig, even enough to compose bodies rather than explode them.
visual_environment.palette: Honey gold, dark wood, cream, muted black, burgundy, and restrained stage white.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Composed, dignified, framed, seated, and given deliberate distance.
visual_environment.motion: Measured, rehearsed, formal, or held between phrases.
visual_environment.density: Balanced and orderly across stage/audience architecture.
visual_environment.material_effects: Print edges and grain calm down; symmetry, proscenium borders, programs, curtains, or formal crop geometry become more legible.

visual_environment.illumination: Vast darkness punctured by banks of hard floodlight and one tiny brilliant performance zone.
visual_environment.palette: Near-black, cold white, saturated stage color, steel gray, and distant crowd glints.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Massive, amplified, anthemic, distant, and almost abstract in scale.
visual_environment.motion: Wave-like crowd motion, large gesture, or a small performer magnified by distance.
visual_environment.density: Extreme contrast between dense mass/crowd and enormous dark volume.
visual_environment.material_effects: Grain, halftone, and repeated points of light emphasize scale; the stage may bloom while people remain documentary rather than heroic.

visual_environment.illumination: Natural daylight under a wide sky, responsive to wind and changing weather rather than theatrical sources.
visual_environment.palette: Sky blue, natural green, sun-warm skin, earth, cloud white, and saturated ordinary color.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Breathable, polyrhythmic, communal, unroofed, and physically exposed to weather.
visual_environment.motion: Wind, walking, bicycles, loose clothing, grass, bodies moving without proscenium.
visual_environment.density: Low-to-moderate with generous horizon/sky or environmental room.
visual_environment.material_effects: Available-light film grain, slightly faded print color, sun flare, airborne dust/pollen, and hand marks that feel made outdoors or on the move.

visual_environment.illumination: Clear public daylight with ordinary street shadows and no privileged theatrical spotlight.
visual_environment.palette: Concrete gray, sky blue, optimistic yellow, poster red, bicycle metal, clothing colors, and public greenery.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Openly social, civic, practical, hopeful, and accountable to many ordinary people.
visual_environment.motion: Walking, talking, gathering, demonstrating, building, cycling, and small coordinated public acts.
visual_environment.density: Moderate distributed human activity; no single celebrity center should swallow the commons.
visual_environment.material_effects: Poster fragments, public signage, notebook marks, map traces, newspaper texture, and spot-color overprint can enter as evidence of collective participation.

visual_environment.illumination: Warm close light on skin and fabric, often soft gold or simple stage white with the external room falling away.
visual_environment.palette: Skin, gray suit cloth, warm gold, sweat-dark fabric, bare wood/floor, and small personal color.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Proprioceptive, barefoot, intimate, direct, and located inside movement rather than around it.
visual_environment.motion: Weight shift, breath, footfall, hand gesture, balance, awkwardness becoming groove.
visual_environment.density: Concentrated on one or several bodies and the small space they actively inhabit.
visual_environment.material_effects: Film grain, motion smear, fabric texture, sweat, pencil/grease marks following joints or trajectories; the body is the diagram and the room.
